evidence.detail: R107 EditorKitController owns a List of this type; c(String) prepends a new instance for each editor status message and the render/update loop iterates only that list.
Construction stores the message and currentTimeMillis; a() returns true only while elapsed time is below exactly 5000 ms, after which the controller removes the notification.
a(x,y) renders the stored message through the editor font as '@yel@[!] @whi@' plus the message and temporarily adjusts font alpha based on elapsed/5000 time to produce a fade.
The exact incoming-reference index shows the only external owner is EditorKitController, so this is Editor Kit support rather than a general client notification type.

candidates.note: EditorKitNotification is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the controller-owned five-second fading status notification.

evidence.detail: The class implements Comparator<EditorEntity> and is constructed directly by EditorKitController.
For each entity it subtracts the client's current cJ/cL coordinates from EditorEntity world/editor X/Y, computes ceil(sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)), and compares the two resulting distances.
The comparator returns distance(second).compareTo(distance(first)), producing descending/far-to-near distance order.
EditorKitController copies its entity list, sorts that copy with this comparator, then iterates the sorted entities through their shared update/render method.

candidates.note: EditorEntityDistanceComparator is directly fixed by its Comparator<EditorEntity> contract, Euclidean distance calculation and controller sort-before-render use.
